steps.text: \[\begin{aligned}&\text{For any two real numbers a and b,}\\[5pt]&\quad \textcolor{#047857}{\textbf{either }\mathbf{a=b,}\textbf{ or }\mathbf{a>b,}\textbf{ or }\mathbf{a<b}}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{(i.e. $\forall$ a, }b\in R,\text{ either }a=b\text{ or }a>b\text{ or }a<\text{ b).}\end{aligned}\]
